summary: The diff correctly updates FlakeColorsSection.tsx to use 17 local image paths with the correct color names in the specified order, and removes external CDN/Unsplash URLs. However, the image paths used are /assets/IMG_xxxx.jpeg instead of the required /assets/generated/IMG_xxxx.jpeg, meaning the images are not loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated as specified in REQ-1.

missing_requirements.requirement: Images must load from frontend/public/assets/generated using local paths only (i.e., /assets/generated/IMG_xxxx.jpeg)
missing_requirements.reason: The diff uses image paths like /assets/IMG_2262.jpeg instead of /assets/generated/IMG_2262.jpeg. The spec explicitly states the images are stored in frontend/public/assets/generated and must be served from that path.
